lia (PM): Quick planning thread — want to lock down a soft-start rollout approach for the new routing+degrade policy. Customer-led requests rolling in, need launch criteria and manual override story.

alex (eng): Proposed flow: staged cohorts + a degraded-mode variant when capacity hits thresholds. Degraded-mode = lower-parameter model + aggressive prefix caching. Keeps latency/SLOs but slightly lower fidelity.

sam (sre): +1 to degrade variant. We need explicit circuit-breaker thresholds and a fast failover. Suggest metrics: p50/p95 latency, error-rate (5xx), call-failure rate, and a quality signal (regression rate vs baseline prompts).

chris (infra): Ops constraints: regional capacity differences. We should have region-aware thresholds and an automated fallback to cheaper model in the same region before cross-region routing. Cross-region adds egress and auth complexity.

maria (sales): We have 2 priority customers asking for early access — they need a manual override that pins them to high-quality path. Can we support per-tenant pinning + emergency opt-out?

alex (eng): Yes, per-tenant pinning is doable via feature flags. Default path = auto-routing, override flag = `pin_to_high_quality`. Manual overrides should bypass autoscaling evictions.

lia (PM): Important: we must negotiate scoping. Do we require per-tenant audit logs for manual overrides at launch? Some ent customers will demand it.

chris (infra): Audit logs are lightweight — we can emit a flag-change event to the audit stream. Add KMS key tagging for Private deploys.

sam (sre): Rollback criteria (automated): if error-rate increases by >0.5% absolute AND p95 latency > 2x SLO for 5m, trigger automatic rollback to previous stable model variant and alert oncall. Manual rollback allowed by oncall.

alex (eng): For canary percentages: start at 0.5% traffic for 30m, then 2% for 2h, then 10% for 4h if metrics stable. A/B: run A (baseline model) vs B (degraded-mode) for quality eval on a seeded prompt set for the first 2% step.

lia (PM): We need clear launch gates: 1) telemetry pipeline shows correct signals, 2) perf labs validated the degraded variant for p50/p95, 3) legal signoff for customer data routing (region constraints), 4) sales-approved pinlist for early customers.

maria (sales): I can supply the customer pinlist. Need a simple UI/CLI to request pinning for a tenant — ideally an API so we can automate.

alex (eng): API sketch for flag change (examples):
```
POST /flags/tenant/{tenant_id}
{
  "flag": "pin_to_high_quality",
  "value": true,
  "reason": "early-access: AcmeCorp",
  "requested_by": "maria"
}
```
Event emitted to `audit.events.flags`.

sam (sre): Add a rate limit on manual pins (n/min) to avoid mass pinning in an incident. Also require 2FA on the UI action for production.

chris (infra): For fallback policy, prefer: 1) local degraded variant, 2) same-region cheaper shard, 3) if still capacity-starved, cross-region but only with explicit opt-in. Document egress cost bump.

lia (PM): Negotiation note: Product will deliver per-tenant pinning + audit + auto fallback. Engineering: scope excludes per-tenant billing delta accounting at launch — defer to next sprint. Sales needs to accept that.

maria (sales): OK to defer billing delta UI, but customers need a clear doc explaining delegated costs.

alex (eng): Action items:
- alex: implement feature-flag API + per-tenant pin enforcement (ETA 2w)
- sam: define SLO thresholds and automated rollback playbook (ETA 1w)
- chris: region-aware fallback policy + audit events (ETA 1.5w)
- lia: draft launch gates doc and customer comms (ETA 3 days)

deploy-bot: canary: started 0.5% -> monitor dashboards https://dash.internal/redwood/rollouts/3899990001 :eyes:

lia (PM): tagging owners in Asana now. We will sync tomorrow at 10am PT to finalize gating. :white_check_mark:
